q06.

The table is **`memo_relation`**.

It stores a link from one memo to another with a relation type. In `repo/store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql` (lines 46–52) it's defined with `memo_id`, `related_memo_id`, and `type`, unique on all three columns. The same table appears in the Postgres and MySQL schemas (`repo/store/migration/postgres/LATEST.sql`, `repo/store/migration/mysql/LATEST.sql`) and was introduced in `repo/store/migration/sqlite/0.13/00__memo_relation.sql`.

Access code lives in `repo/store/db/sqlite/memo_relation.go`, `repo/store/db/postgres/memo_relation.go`, and `repo/store/db/mysql/memo_relation.go`, with the store-level types in `repo/store/memo_relation.go`.
